name: What is the step-by-step process for building a bedroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for building a bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The construction process moves through several defined stages: initial consultation and site assessment, architectural design, permitting, site preparation, foundation pouring, framing, mechanical rough-ins (electrical, HVAC, plumbing), insulation, drywall installation, and finishing touches. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms assigns project managers to oversee each trade and inspect framing and drywall work before paint and trim. Clear communication throughout these phases ensures structural blending with the existing home exterior and interior surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves planning and permitting, foundation work, framing, rough electrical and HVAC, drywall hanging, and completing interior and exterior trim.
